secondary_acceptance: positive pooled gain and positive gain in at least 3 of 5 folds
bootstrap: 600 paired stratified resamples conditional on primary OOF predictions; does not capture training/selection uncertainty
two_seed_final_bagging_gate: Only if averaging both OOF seeds improves on the better individual seed by >0.00015 for both baseline and candidate. This is a development diagnostic, not an independent test.
historical_audit: Never used for new selection or retuning; no new untouched-audit claim
public_score: 0.7654 remains a historical fallback; new public score unknown
limited_three_model_blends: Frozen public pair plus a new model; also best primary pair plus one complementary model, keeping 50/75/90 percent of that pair. No fourth-model search.
representation_ablation: Advance the native-missing lean model if it beats the reproduced inner baseline, in addition to top new CatBoost candidates; compare native handling with and without term proxies.
